governance.model: Advice and consent — not majority rule
flow: Propose: Share idea freely (RFC, IDEA, APP)
Seek advice: Gather input from affected parties
Address concerns: No objection goes unheard
Consent: Proceed when no reasoned objections remain
principles: Good enough for now, safe enough to try
No majority rule — 49% opposition is still failure
No authority — decisions emerge from consent
Address objections — every concern must be heard
